checks.DEC-55: GX.AlmostTrivialCC is the literal definition: gamma is in OmegaSet U x x (a subset of C(I,X), mathlib's compact-open topology), and for every V in nhds x, connectedComponentIn (OmegaSet U x x) gamma meets OmegaSet (V cap U) x x. It is faithful to l.1212. Homotopic implies same component in general (OmegaHomotopic.mem_connectedComponentIn). The converse for almost triviality (almostTrivialCC_iff) holds for U open and semilocally simply connected with X LPC; it is proved, not assumed. Every later row is stated with the CC notions (AlmostHomotopicCC, OmegaRel, carthesian_S2_almostTrivial).
checks.DEC-56: (c) IsStandardNbhd = the component of e in p^-1(V), V open connected around p(e), matching the ruling. (e) FreePath/FreeHomotopic: paths and homotopies in Y minus S, start fixed, end free in U. (f) IsEmbedding Phi together with range Phi = the projective limit, each pi_1 given the discrete topology (bottom). (g) IsHomTrivial: a fixed-end homotopy to refl x lying in U for s < 1 and 0 < t < 1. Since O is in S_i, the constant loop is not itself in Omega(O,O,U), so the s < 1 condition is the only sensible form, and it makes the negation in claim 4 as strong as possible.
checks.statement_fidelity: Checked against the paper's statements and proofs. lem:almost_homotopic_carac and lem:hausdorff_first_countable_connected add 'U semilocally simply connected', but only for (i) => (ii) and for transitivity; reflexivity, symmetry and (ii) => (i) are proved with no hypothesis. These rows are partial and unmarked, which DEC-55 allows ('the implication is proved or the row stays partial'). lem:almost_homotopic_carac2 and theo:ramified_covering_path add 'S skeletal, Y minus S slsc', the conditions under which widetilde Y^S exists (prop:universality, l.1158); the theorem's proof also uses slsc at l.1349. Both rows are partial and reported. prop:general_fiber_path takes cov (covering over S^c) and S skeletal. Both follow from 'branched over S' (S is the branching locus, whose complement is portly; GX.isCoveringMap_restrict_compl), and X LPC/T2 and Y T1/locally connected are within the standing assumptions (l.813, l.962), so the hypotheses are weaker than the paper's. No vacuous hypotheses: cartgamma is an explicit loop in Omega(O,O,R^3 minus S2) (it crosses z = 0 only at (0,4,0)), and fiber_above_homeomorphic proves skeletality and slsc rather than assuming them.

issues.problem: Item (ii)'s 'gamma is homotopic to ... in Omega(x,x,U)' is formalized as an explicit homotopy (OmegaHomotopic). Under the literal l.1201, which DEC-55 applies to almost triviality, 'homotopic with respect to U' is 'same connected component of Omega(x,x,U)'. The choice of reading is not disclosed in SCOPE or questions. The homotopy form is the stronger (ii) and is what lem:hausdorff's proof consumes, so the (i) => (ii) direction is not weakened. But the component-form converse, (ii_c) => (i), is not stated. It is trivial: the splice lies in Omega(x,x,V cap U).
issues.fix: Add a SCOPE/question line recording that (ii)'s 'homotopic' is read as a homotopy. Optionally add the component-form converse, (ii_c) => (i), with no hypothesis, and state whether (i) => (ii_c) in the component reading is still open without slsc.

issues.problem: The row is partial only because S is skeletal and Y minus S is slsc, which are exactly the hypotheses under which the notation widetilde Y^S is defined (prop:universality). No question asks the author whether the notation carries those hypotheses; if it does, the row closes. Also, almost_homotopic_carac2_of_isMaximal_cc assumes [T2Space X] [LocPathConnectedSpace X] [FirstCountableTopology X] on the covering space, and the hypotheses list does not mention these. They are covered by the standing assumptions (l.962), so this is a reporting gap only.
issues.fix: Add a question: 'Does widetilde Y^S in lem:almost_homotopic_carac2 presuppose prop:universality's hypotheses (S skeletal, Y minus S slsc)? If so, the row closes.' List the X instances as carried (standing assumptions l.962).

summary: Paths.lean typechecks with 0 errors and 0 warnings. It has 0 sorry in code, and all 26 labelled theorems depend only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The three former tagged sorries (the S2 claims of ex:consider_carthesian_coordinates_usual) are genuinely closed. DEC-55 is applied correctly: GX.AlmostTrivialCC is the literal compact-open-component definition, and every row is stated with it. The bridge to the homotopy form (almostTrivialCC_iff, for U open slsc in an LPC X) is proved, not assumed. DEC-56 (c)(e)(f)(g) are implemented as ruled. Closed/marked versus partial/unmarked status is honest for all 12 labels. Every hypothesis added (slsc of U, or of Y minus S with S skeletal) is reported, and is either used by the paper's own proof or needed for widetilde Y^S to exist. No name clashes, and the Galois consumer still typechecks. There are five minor issues: (1) the closed row ex:consider_fiber_above_homeomorphic is invisible to the ledger, because its bold mark starts at character offset 4000 (kb/0006 item 2); (2) the reading of 'homotopic' in lem:almost_homotopic_carac (ii) is undisclosed; (3) the carac2 row has no question to the author; (4) single-claim docstrings of a partial row are bold; (5) the paper's names still denote the homotopy form. No blocker or major issue.
